guest.bio_context: Brad Wetherall spent more than a decade at Google leading operations for Google Business Profile, formerly known as Google My Business, the platform connecting businesses with customers through Google Search and Maps. He came to the United States from Australia in 2000 and built a consulting business in the early 2000s during the dot-com boom before his work was acquired by JPMorgan Chase, where he ran an operations team. At Google, he worked on multiple products including Google Wallet, Google Pay, Google Domains, and Google Shopping before leaving two years ago to join Esquire Digital, where he now helps law firms build visibility and credibility as AI changes how people find lawyers.
